panels.detailed_description: White A at upper left identifies a gray longitudinal chest/lung section on a dark rectangular background. A mottled red peripheral glow with yellow, green and white areas overlays much of the upper portion of the lung-shaped dark region. Bright branching white structures and fine texture extend across the colored region; the lower curved dark portion has markedly less colored overlay. No numeric perfusion percentage, labeled volume, HU threshold, caliper, scale, color-key legend or arrow is printed. Appearance alone does not identify the patient, quantify perfusion or establish emphysema.

panels.detailed_description: Black B appears above a white-background schematic with two tall lung-like outlines. Their upper portions are white and lower lobar-shaped regions are shaded pale and darker gray. Oblique dividing lines and a row of pale dots appear in the image-left profile; a thick curved black line runs along the outer lower side of the image-right profile. The image is a simplified outline/lobar drawing, with no acquired anatomical texture, measurements, numeric labels, arrows, directional connections, plotted axes or legends. No physiological result is calculated from the shaded drawing.
